Join Our Vision: We are building the next generation of Spatial Media - a new way people experience videos through interaction, multi-user presence, haptics, AI, and immersive storytelling.
 DeoVR is the leading immersive streaming technology serving multiple enterprise customers and millions of users globally.
 We are now expanding the boundaries of what video can be - moving from passive watching to active, interactive, multi-user journeys.
 If this excites you more than it scares you, you are in the right place.
 The Role 
 We are looking for a colleague to join our QA Unity team in the segment of a **global VR video streaming ecosystem.
 What You Will Do 

• Conduct functional and non-functional manual testing of our web, mobile and VR applications to identify defects and inconsistencies.

• Perform root cause analysis of the issues, report and track them.

• Contribute to prevention strategy of the identified issues.

• Create and improve test documentation to facilitate the testing process.

• Collaborate with the team and stakeholders on quality improvement, issue resolving and requirements refinement.

• Provide clear and non-ambiguous reporting on tasks progress, notifying about obstacles in a timely manner.

• Readiness to pair testing and knowledge share with other members of the QA team, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

 What We Are Looking For 

• Experience in testing VR applications.

• 3+ years of experience in software testing.

• Strong background in web and mobile testing.

• Familiarity with Jira and TestRail.

• Keen attention to details.

• Fluency in English and Russian.

 Bonus Points 

• Experience with video streaming (VOD & cam-streams).

• Experience in API testing.

• Background in testing PWA applications for Android.

• Experience in automation for Unity.

 Hiring Process 

• HR Screening (up to 30 min)

• Tech Interview (up to 1,5 hours)

• CEO Interview (30 min)

 💼 Explore our hiring process.
 What We Offer 
 Please note, that this is a fully remote contract role. B2B cooperation only – you will work with us as an independent contractor operating through your own legal business entity (e.g., sole proprietorship, limited company, or equivalent).

• The chance to be part of a pioneering team in a rapidly evolving industry

• Direct impact on the future of media and technology

• Flexible working hours to accommodate your lifestyle

• Work remotely from almost anywhere

• A culture that values innovation, accountability, and collaboration

• Access to the tech you need from day one

• A dynamic and innovative work environment in a cutting-edge industry

 🎥 Unlocking Immersive Experiences: Ivan Varko’s vision, CEO of Infomediji .
